customer_segment.value: B2C: Older adults, people with disabilities or chronic illnesses, and other home care, home health and hospice patients

quotes.quote: A lot has changed in the more than 40 years since Addus began back but our core objective remains the same: providing great care for the elderly, disabled and chronically ill, especially those who are at risk of hospitalization or institutionalization. We started out as a home cleaning service and then began providing chore services to Chicago’s at-risk elderly population through a contract with the city.

Addus refined its strategy to focus on growth in the states in which we have a current presence while adding clinical care services to our offerings. We now provide personal care to over 42,000 patients while providing home health and hospice services to over 3,600 patients. We now have multiple offices in 22 states.
